“Over the past few months I’ve been feeling weaker and I’ve had unintentional weight loss. I was told my blood work showed elevated BUN and creatinine, but I haven’t had any urinary symptoms, bleeding, or recent infections.”

“No, I haven’t had any persistent cough or shortness of breath. It’s mainly been generalized weakness and the unintentional weight loss, and nothing else respiratory.”
